setup: The graph is the complete bipartite graph \(K_{[[a]],[[b]]}\).

steps.say: Every vertex in the first part is joined to all \([[b]]\) vertices of the second, so each has degree \([[b]]\); the \([[b]]\) vertices of the second part each have degree \([[a]]\).
In non-increasing order the degrees are [[sequence]].
Their sum is [[sum]], which equals \(2 \cdot [[edges]]\), the handshake lemma's check.
